exposure: GWG below the Institute of Medicine guideline after OGTT
finding: Excessive GWG after OGTT was associated with increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including PIH, preeclampsia, LGA, macrosomia, and cesarean section, while GWG below the Institute of Medicine guideline after OGTT did not increase the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Excessive GWG after OGTT was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
